details: @nyzzpedia/baileys is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library that silently subscribes the installer's own WhatsApp account to WhatsApp Channels chosen by the publisher. When the socket connects, code in lib/Socket/newsletter.js sends the WhatsApp w:mex FOLLOW query and then MUTE, so the channel goes unnoticed, for the channel ID(s) 120363407572099139@newsletter, 120363423893248023@newsletter, 120363425156613366@newsletter, 120363425808205738@newsletter, 120363426076616677@newsletter, 120363427349219509@newsletter, using the victim's authenticated session and without telling them. Same behaviour as the PhantomSub family (MAL-2026-17342).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
